name: mvp re-engagement interpretation is provider-driven with zero keyword matching — owner wording threaded VERBATIM, and an out-of-spec request fails closed without inventing a criterion (PHASE-56 W-2, R-12/R-22/F-5)
description: PHASE-56 W-2. The owner's follow-up is classified ONLY by a provider (PHASE-54 R-8/R-12 pattern carried forward: no String.includes, no regex on owner text). Four legs, all mock-keyed by SCENARIO_TAG. (a) MORE_WORK: the chosen ids come back, the owner's sentence is stored VERBATIM in the append-only slice record, and the reply names the added criteria. (b) NOT_IN_SPEC: the owner clearly asks for more work that NO remaining acceptance criterion covers — Forge refuses in plain Arabic, creates NO loop, appends NO slice, invents NO criterion, and leaves the block in ACCEPTED. (c) NOT_A_BUILD_REQUEST: a non-build turn leaves everything untouched. (d) hardening: a provider proposing an id that was never offered, and a malformed provider payload, are BOTH rejected typed — the code decides, the provider only proposes.
